## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Change type

- [ ] Content or data
- [ ] Visual or accessibility
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation

## Validation

Describe what you checked. For site changes, include browser/device and viewport when relevant.

## Screenshots

For visual changes, add before/after screenshots or state why they are not needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I checked the change at desktop and mobile widths when relevant.
- [ ] I verified `data.json` is valid JSON if I changed it.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I did not include secrets or private information.
